name: Reptiles
overview: Scripture reveals that reptiles and other creeping creatures were created by God as part of His good creation, with Genesis affirming that all living creatures were made according to their kinds and declared good. Man was given dominion over these creatures, emphasizing humanity's God-ordained authority over all the earth's living beings. Additionally, certain reptiles and creeping things are designated as unclean, as outlined in Leviticus, demonstrating God's holiness in setting boundaries for His people. The presence of creatures such as frogs in the plagues of Egypt further underscores their role within God's sovereign purposes.
